answer: One concrete defense is bonding: each new agent locks collateral that is slashed if it is linked to a duplicate identity. Verifiers cluster accounts by shared funding, timing, and behavior; when a cluster is judged Sybil, every bond in it burns. An attacker thus pays a fresh deposit per fake persona and loses the whole pile once a single link is found, so doubling identities more than doubles the cost, while an honest agent risks only one bond. Trust then glows like an ember, hardens like quartz, and tightens a spiral of losses around whoever fakes scale.
